At this rate, Trump is going to demand the Justice Department open a criminal investigation of the pope....Hello?

Kudos to Pope Leo for his moral clarity — and for not backing down. https://robertreich.substack.com/p/leo

Clarence Thomas ruled in favor of Citizens United.

Harlan Crow's political contributions then went up 862%.

Then we later find out Thomas let Crow take him on lavish trips, buy his mom's house, and help fund his wife's conservative nonprofit.

But go on about how "progressivism" is a problem...

Trump has been losing it for a while now, but in the last few months it’s become far worse.

This has put all of us in danger.

"The test of our progress is not whether we add more to the abundance of those who have much; it is whether we provide enough for those who have too little."

-FDR, 1937

While death and destruction rained down on Iran during the war’s first month, the world’s 100 biggest oil and gas companies brought in an extra $30 million per HOUR in windfall profits.

Yes, $30 million per HOUR. 

All because of the deadly and reckless decision making of one man.

New York is taxing the rich.

NYC Mayor Mamdani and Gov. Kathy Hochul announced a tax on second homes worth over $5 million.

While Trump rolls out the red carpet for his billionaire friends, states and cities are leading the charge to tackle out-of-control inequality. Let’s keep it up.

You’re probably going to hear a lot about what the rich really pay in taxes today.

This chart tells the real story.

Apple is closing its first unionized store in the country.

Reminder that Apple spent $700B+ on stock buybacks over the past decade. 

CEO Tim Cook raked in over $74M in compensation in 2025 — 650 times the median Apple employee's pay.

The greed of union-busters knows no end.

Trump has launched three more boat strikes this week, bringing the total death toll to 177.

Remember: No judge or jury has found these boats were trafficking drugs. We're taking Trump's word for it.

This is murder. We must not lose sight of this lawlessness.

HEY DMV AREA!

Come see me on my Who’s With Me? stand-up comedy tour THIS FRIDAY, April 17 in North Bethesda, MD

Tickets at wkamaubell.com

Under Trump, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau has been all but destroyed.

That means less oversight of shady financial actors — including the booming "Buy Now, Pay Later" industry.

Former CFPB Director Rohit Chopra explains how consumers are paying the price.

Allbirds was a shoe company whose business was declining. Eventually, the company sold off its assets for less than 1% of its previous valuation.

But when it announced it would rebrand from shoes to AI, its market value jumped more than 500%.

Wondering if AI is a bubble? Watch this.

For the good of the nation and the world, it’s time we face the reality: The most powerful man in the world does not have the mental capacity to do the job. https://robertreich.substack.com/p/hes-losing-all-his-marbles

🚨YOU CAN'T MAKE THIS UP: IRS data show 164 taxpayers with an average unreported foreign account balance of $1.3 billion were identified for examination - but only 12 were audited.

The agency didn't do more audits even after they discovered $39 million of taxes owed among the 12.
There is no justification for today’s extraordinary concentration of wealth at the very top. It’s distorting our politics, rigging our markets and granting unprecedented power to a handful of people.

For nearly a half century, trickle-down economic policies have resulted in a tax system rigged in favor of the rich. This is not only bad for our economy, but it’s leading to a billionaire takeover of our democracy as well. Watch. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wkiO0_uSJAk
Wondering if wealth inequality is out of control?
Today seems like a good day to ask the question: Should billionaires exist? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eTAlWw9Hbcg
You’re probably going to hear a lot about what the rich really pay in taxes today. This chart tells the real story.
Is "Buy Now, Pay Later" too good to be true? Former CFPB Director Rohit Chopra shines a light on its hidden costs for borrowers — and our entire economy.
What do you call a system where CEOs make millions of dollars while laying off thousands of workers?
There is one force more powerful than Trump. My friend Amy Goodman explains.
Trump's Iran War is going so badly, even MAGA diehards are turning on him.
I've said it before and I'll say it again: trickle-down economics is a cruel joke.

@rokhannausa is absolutely right. When the President of the United States threatens genocide against millions of innocent people, Democratic leadership should stand in clear moral opposition — not hide behind procedure.

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind. It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax. Don't fall for their fearmongering. A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Why does the American tax system favor the wealthy? And how did it get this way? I chatted with Jon Stewart about this back in 2012. Sadly it's only gotten worse since then. We must keep up the fight to fix the system.
